title: The website editor wears the Frequency design system's Site Editor, not the theme of the site it edits
detail: Owner ask 2026-10-14 (The Group's editor at thegrouplocal.com/admin/editor): the editor did not look like the design system, and picking a section in the left rail did not move the page. Ported design_handoff_site_editor (high fidelity) onto production's shell, canvas and inspector, keeping the data layer, autosave, publish and block registry. The chrome wears the system's Commons tokens and Unbounded / Hanken Grotesk faces, scoped to components/sites/editor/editor.css and loaded by the editor alone; the site theme now dresses only the canvas frame. Top bar (back, Space identity, page menu with status dots, save state, rail folds, device segment, undo/redo, preview, presence, gradient Publish with the pending count), left rail (icon tabs, Layers rows with a type icon, the section's own line and its position or Live, locked Header and Footer rows, footer with Live site), dotted stage with a framed canvas and zoom, Vera as a bottom command bar, inspector header with Section N of M and Content / Design / Advanced / Notes tabs, Duplicate / Delete footer, and the canvas's violet type tag, dark toolbar with Hide on this device, and hover insert points. A Layers pick scrolls the canvas to the section. The Network and Wildheart faces now reach the canvas (registered on the editor route, copied into the frame), so the canvas renders the theme's own type.
